name: LookupRangeInExcelWorksheetNode
label: Lookup Range in Excel Worksheet
description: Looks up a value in a specified range and returns the corresponding value from another column or the cell address.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The Excel Worksheet in which to perform the lookup.

fields.name: LookupValue
fields.label: Lookup Value
fields.description: The value to look for in the search column.

fields.name: SearchColumn
fields.label: Search Column
fields.description: The column letter or number to search in.

fields.name: StartRow
fields.label: Start Row
fields.description: The starting row of the range to search.

fields.name: EndRow
fields.label: End Row
fields.description: The ending row of the range to search. If 0, uses the last row with data.

fields.name: ResultColumn
fields.label: Result Column
fields.description: The column from which to return the result value. If empty, returns the found cell address.

fields.name: MatchCase
fields.label: Match Case
fields.description: Whether the lookup should be case-sensitive.

fields.name: FoundValue
fields.label: Found Value
fields.description: The value found in the result column corresponding to the lookup value.

fields.name: FoundRow
fields.label: Found Row
fields.description: The row number where the lookup value was found.

fields.name: FoundCellAddress
fields.label: Found Cell Address
fields.description: The cell address where the lookup value was found.

fields.name: ValueFound
fields.label: Value Found
fields.description: Indicates whether the lookup value was found.
